# Suppress Show-Through

> 🤖 *AI Drafted (Not reviewed)*

Push the faint mirrored writing of the other side to paper and keep the ink; method b also reads the verso, without modifying source files.

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `compression_quality` | integer | 90 | JPEG/WebP compression quality. |
| `gain` | number | — | Method b: the verso's share seen through; empty fits it. |
| `k` | number | 0.25 | A mark lighter than this fraction of the page's ink darkness is show-through. |
| `method` | string | a | a: the page alone. b: the page and its verso (mirrored, registered, subtracted). One of: a, b. |
| `output_dir` | string | — | Optional output directory. Defaults to a temp directory. |
| `output_format` | string | jpg | Derived image format. One of: jpg, png, tiff, webp. |
| `verso_path` | string | — | Method b: the verso image file, when it is not handed to `run`. |
| `window_divisor` | integer | 60 | The paper estimate's closing kernel is the long side divided by this. |
